**Show your assistant what you mean, right on the window.**

KnightSight now has a pinboard. While you share, you pin notes straight onto the shared window or region, and your assistant gets every note together with the spot it belongs to. You don't have to describe in the chat where the cut-off button sits.

## ✨ Added

- **The pinboard.** While you share, Ctrl+Shift+A (Cmd+Shift+A on a Mac) or the new pin button in the KnightSight window opens it over the share, and the same key closes it again. Drag a box around a spot or click to set a pin, then write what you noticed and mark it as a bug, a wish or a question. Hold Shift to give the same note more spots. The notes stay on their spots when the window moves or changes its size.
- **Done hands the notes to your assistant.** The new `pinboard` tool returns each note with its kind, text and author, the place of every spot in the coordinates `look` and `click` use, a picture of each spot and the whole share with labelled markers. With `wait` it waits for you to press Done, so your assistant can ask you to pin something and then wait for your notes.
- **Save as file** keeps the notes as one HTML page with the pictures inside, for when no assistant is there to fetch them.
- **The shortcut is only taken while you share.** Other programs use Ctrl+Shift+A too, and they get it back as soon as the share ends.
- **On Linux** the pinboard lies over the share on X11 with a compositor. On Wayland, which lets no program draw over other windows, it opens as a window with a picture of the share instead.
